repository.name: relay-core
repository.description: Core backend services and real-time synchronization engine for student hackathon collaboration.

readme.content:
# CodeSync Relay Core

Core backend platform for real-time collaboration and project management.

## Architecture
- Runtime: Node.js with TypeScript and Express
- Real-time: Socket.IO authenticated rooms
- Primary Database: MongoDB is our chosen primary database for all collections, user records, and metadata.
- AI Services: Python FastAPI microservice with vector search

## Running the Project
Run `npm install` and `npm run dev` to start the local development server.

issues.title: Fix user profile update validation bug

issues.title: Database engine decision: MongoDB vs PostgreSQL
issues.author: marcus-brody
issues.body: Contradiction in repository: README states MongoDB is the primary database, while PR #12 implements PostgreSQL migration. Need formal sign-off before merging.

issues.title: Security audit: Add rate limiting to authentication endpoints
issues.author: security-bot
issues.body: Security risk: /api/v1/auth/login currently has no strict rate limit. We must enforce express-rate-limit to protect against brute force attacks.
